snippet.title: Dreamsend: Wintersong | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Dreamsend: Wintersong is a 2.5D cyberpunk-fantasy Strategy RPG. Master deep tactical combat and utilize strategies to lead your party through a series of challenging battles and epic multiphase boss fights. Survive and uncover a foreboding catastrophe looming over Veichne, the land trapped in eternal winters.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4339210
